detail.name: Ju Fufu's Namecard
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Ju Fufu's Mindscape: Righteous Young Hero
detail.desc2:
A card imprinted with the image of Yunkui Summit's most senior disciple.
Instead of dialing her number, the sect's exclusive voice-transmission technique calls a disciple in an instant. So beyond the contact details, it even includes the incantation to call the "super scary big tiger":
Senior, Shifu has been kidnapped by Ethereals!
